  "reason": "Customer is asking a pre-purchase product question about pack capacity for a trip.",
  "reply_draft": "Hi Hamish, thanks for reaching out! The Trailhead 45L and 55L packs share the same harness system and durable ripstop fabric, but the 55L has a slightly longer torso extension and an extra external pocket for longer trips. For a 3-day tramp, either can work depending on your gear volume, and our team would be happy to help you decide based on your setup."
